article.title: 자기 y vinculación reflexiva
article.part: Sintaxis discursiva compleja — 복합 담화 통사

claims.summary: Lee (2006) da prioridad analítica a la vinculación gramatical en 자기, usando la logoforicidad para recuperar referencias de reflexivos no ligados; Choi (2014) propone un análisis de 자기 como pronombre ligado-variable y aborda casos locales como parte de su argumento.

locator.description: KCI article abstract, lines 45–47: Lee (2006) tests caki and casin for syntactic properties and logophoricity (SELF, SOURCE, PIVOT); concludes grammatical binding is core and logophoricity helps recover reference of unbound reflexives.
KCI article abstract, lines 48–51: Choi (2014) argues caki is a bound-variable pronoun and treats viewpoint/logophoricity as additional to c-command; lines 192–200 give article metadata.
